Old edition reading place, Meaning mode, pace 200 and reflections migrate without changing old bytes
Learning import merges bookmarks and conflicting notes, retains settings, and is idempotent
Malformed and wrong-edition imports are refused without changing saved data
Reload keeps the selected occurrence, depth and latest notes
malformed JSON: original bytes survive reading and recovery export
future saved schema: original bytes survive reading and recovery export
unknown saved field: original bytes survive reading and recovery export
A delayed file import is cancelled after its tools session closes and another bani opens
Two real tabs serialize editors and preserve disjoint notes and bookmarks
The real root worker verifies and caches all 73 assets, including Nitnem, Sukhmani and both Salok collections
All six new banis load exact complete text and meanings with the network offline
Canonical Japji and the complete Sukhmani remain readable under the same offline worker
A new worker waits for explicit action, then preserves the open reflection during activation
No uncaught browser runtime errors

limitations: No physical iPhone, Safari Home Screen, VoiceOver or device airplane-mode acceptance.
Offline navigation uses Chromium network emulation and the real root service worker.
The update check changes only the served worker version in this isolated server; it does not publish or alter repository assets.
